Selected haḷid/halid/hoḷid/oḷid/həlid/hoḷed/haḷed/hoḷdi/oldi/holdi/halit preserve regional vowel raising/rounding, h loss, metathesis and final devoicing notation. Local Indo-Aryan transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: oldi.
